verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap at pooran pragaas prem nem kai parasapar hai ||

en.bdb: Significance of an obedient disciple of True Guru meeting with His congregation is highly astonishing. Having adhered to all conditions and code of mutual love, light divine of the perfect Lord glows in him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਰਸਿ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਕੋਮਲ ਪੂਜਾ ਕੋੋਟਿ ਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal raj baasanaa subaas ras seetalataa komal poojaa kooT na samasar hai ||

en.bdb: With the acquisition of elixir-like Naam in the fragrant presence of True Guru, he experiences such tranquillity that no worship of the world can equate with.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਨ ਪਟੰਤਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: roop kai anoop roop at asacharaj mai naadh bisamaadh raag raaganee na paTa(n)tar hai ||

en.bdb: Because of spiritual beauty, a Guru-oriented person is beautiful of form. In a state of awe and wonder, he is absorbed in trance-giving melody that cannot be compared with any form or mode of singing in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੮੫॥
verses.translit_en: nijhar apaar dhaar a(n)mirat nidhaan paan paramadhabhut gat aan naahee samasar hai ||285||

en.bdb: By perpetual practicing of meditation on elixir-like Naam, a perpetual flow of the divine elixir takes place from the mystical tenth door. This state is incomparable with any other in the world for its shear ecstasy and bliss. (285)
